title: She always held the umbrella... ☔ #shorts
description:
Every rainy day, she tilted the umbrella toward him. He never noticed she was the one getting wet.

Years later, it was his turn.

Hold the umbrella for the ones who once held it for you. ❤️

Tag someone who always held the umbrella for you.
